sections.title: Frost and freezing damage: factors affecting plant injury
sections.text: Reviewed summary of UC IPM home and landscape guidance. Cold injury depends on minimum temperature, duration of cold, rate of cooling, season and plant characteristics. Age, hydration, affected tissue and cold acclimation influence damage. Sensitive plants may benefit from suitable overnight covers during frost conditions, but protection is limited during freezing without a heat source. A single species temperature descriptor cannot establish that seedlings will survive a particular frost. Field decisions require local conditions and crop-specific guidance.
